# Display tables (outward rounding from the stored exact rationals)

Generated by `tools/display_tables.py`. Every lower end is the exact lower end rounded down and every upper end
the exact upper end rounded up, to 18 decimals unless stated. Source fields: `delta_lo` / `delta_hi` (P2a-P2c),

delta = M_ADM - 1 at mu = 1; j = 4J; chi = J / M_ADM^2.
